sales_hooks: GE Vernova's transformer lead time is 18-36 months — every new AI data center is power-constrained before it's GPU-constrained. HBM demand is gated by GE Vernova's backlog.
GE Vernova's gas turbine orders from hyperscalers are a 24-month leading indicator of where large-scale GPU clusters (and thus HBM) will be deployed geographically.
Power demand for GB200 NVL72 racks: >100kW per rack; a 100K GPU cluster needs ~1GW of dedicated power — GE Vernova is the primary beneficiary of this new power demand class.
Nuclear + AI: Microsoft's Three Mile Island deal, Google's Kairos SMR partnership — GE Vernova's nuclear expertise positions it as the long-term clean power partner for hyperscalers.
